The girl on the left wears a grey blazer-style crop top and skirt, the center girl wears a white cap and black jacket, and the girl on the right wears a white long-sleeve top with pink ribbons. (2) Prompted by a voice, all three girls turn around and run away from the camera towards a red snack cart, laughing. (3) They return to the original spot, breathing heavily but smiling; the camera remains static. (4) The girls engage in a playful debate, gesturing with their hands and changing their facial expressions from focused to humorous. (5) In the background, a person in a Snoopy costume is seen bending over a purple bench, which the girls notice and point at. (6) The video transitions through several rounds of the game where they run or stay based on prompts, with frequent close-ups on their reactions.

(2) A sharp 'ding' sound effect rings out as the female speakers begin screaming and laughing simultaneously while running. (3) The female voices transition into rapid-fire conversational Chinese, overlapping as they discuss their answers, while the BGM maintains a steady, upbeat energy. (4) Another prompt is given by the male voice followed by a percussive 'thud' SFX, triggering a renewed burst of high-pitched female laughter and footsteps on the pavement.
